fieldValues.title: Close the cycle and report
fieldValues.description: Gather the cycle (previous close to this close, daily at 11:30 UTC at the current rhythm), escalate stops and over-budget items as proposed decisions, write the run-report and post it on semanticops.com#31 with the wg-report marker line.
fieldValues.done_when: A run-report record exists for the cycle and the same report is a comment on semanticops.com#31 starting with the wg-report marker line.
fieldValues.trigger: Daily 11:30 UTC (the cycle close; the owner can amend the rhythm)
